title: Noor and the Inheritance
author: Noor Almeida
blurb: Noor Okafor, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
